diagnosis: Atypical cells from an indeterminate breast lesion on imaging at ROSE indicated a need to perform a CNB
legend: FNAB shows 3D epithelial tissue fragments and dispersed cells with a bloody background. CNB showed poorly differentiated carcinoma. (Giemsa)

Indeterminate on imaging, suggestive of fat necrosis, with a non-palpable breast mass in a patient with a history of breast carcinoma. FNAB showed dispersed malignant cells consistent with carcinoma in a fatty background. (Giemsa)
Imaging was suggestive of a rounded cystic lesion or fibroadenoma. ROSE showed dispersed cells in a background suggestive of mucin, and carcinoma with prominent mucin was diagnosed. (Giemsa)
An example of a commercial kit for a Giemsa-based stain on air-dried smears allows staining of the slides in 30 seconds. The slides are rinsed in water and can be interpreted immediately on site.
